hunks.baseline: Along with the cheerful System notification, the sensations that had briefly fallen away began to return.
hunks.sol: With the cheerful System notification, the senses that had briefly fallen away began to return.

hunks.baseline: And the hands gripping and shaking both my shoulders, along with someone's shouting.
hunks.sol: And the hands gripping my shoulders and shaking me, accompanied by someone’s shouts.

hunks.baseline: At the urgent voices drilling into my ears—two voices, no, one monster and one human—I blinked.
hunks.sol: At the two urgent voices drilling into my ears—no, the voices of one monster and one human—I blinked.

hunks.baseline: After taking a completely unexpected slap, I answered in a dazed voice.
hunks.sol: Stunned by the completely unexpected slap, I answered in a daze.

hunks.baseline: “What is wrong with you?! We’ve been trying to wake you up! Why are you only getting up now?!”
hunks.sol: “What is wrong with you?! We tried everything to wake you! Why are you only getting up now?!”

hunks.baseline: Talk about forceful. This was the first time I had ever seen Team Leader Choi this furious.
hunks.sol: Talk about intense. This was the first time I had ever seen Team Leader Choi so furious.

hunks.baseline: Lightning was practically shooting from the eyes of the man who usually remained calm no matter what happened and spent his time showing off designer goods.
hunks.sol: Lightning practically shot from the eyes of the man who stayed calm no matter what happened and spent his time showing off designer goods.

hunks.baseline: *But what’s wrong with him? We’re still on the plane, aren’t we?*
hunks.sol: *But what’s gotten into him? We’re still on the plane, aren’t we?*

hunks.baseline: I had apologized reflexively, but I was still bewildered. Was this really enough to earn a slap?
hunks.sol: I had apologized reflexively, but I was still bewildered. Had I really done something worth slapping me over?

hunks.baseline: The rest of Team Leader Choi’s words were drowned out by the flight attendants’ screams. Shouts from men I presumed were the pilots followed.
hunks.sol: The rest of Team Leader Choi’s words were drowned out by the flight attendants’ screams. Shouts from men I assumed were the pilots followed.

hunks.baseline: “…What the hell?”
hunks.sol: “…What the fuck?”

hunks.baseline: What on earth was happening?
hunks.sol: What the hell was happening?

hunks.baseline: As I frantically looked around, Team Leader Choi threw out an unbelievable statement.
hunks.sol: As I frantically looked around, Team Leader Choi dropped a bombshell.

hunks.baseline: What kind of bullshit was this? We were flying at an altitude of twenty-five thousand feet in a private jet sent by China’s Central Committee.
hunks.sol: What kind of bullshit was that? We were flying at twenty-five thousand feet in a private jet sent by China’s Central Committee.

hunks.baseline: By now, it shouldn’t have been strange to see our destination, Chengdu International Airport in Sichuan Province—
hunks.sol: By now, it wouldn’t have been strange to see our destination, Chengdu International Airport in Sichuan Province—

hunks.baseline: I absentmindedly turned my head to look out the window, then stared with my mouth hanging open.
hunks.sol: I turned to look out the window and stared with my mouth hanging open.

hunks.baseline: Far below, a vast airport spread out beneath us. Flames surged upward, and countless large and small dots moved across the grounds.
hunks.sol: Far below, flames surged from the sprawling airport while dots of every size moved across the grounds.

hunks.baseline: It was a battle. A savage fight to the death between humans and monsters was taking place.
hunks.sol: It was a battle. Humans and monsters were fighting each other to the death.

hunks.baseline: And that was not all.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic monster’s body rapidly approached the private jet I was riding in.
hunks.sol: A gigantic monster was rapidly closing in on our private jet.

hunks.baseline: They were bastards I would hate to encounter even on the ground, but I especially did not want to meet them at twenty-five thousand feet.
hunks.sol: They were bastards I wouldn’t want to meet even on the ground, let alone at twenty-five thousand feet.

hunks.baseline: *…What the hell kind of situation is this?*
hunks.sol: *…What kind of fucked-up situation is this?*

hunks.baseline: A fierce battle was raging around Chengdu International Airport below, while a group of Wyverns pursued the private jet I was riding in at twenty-five thousand feet.
hunks.sol: A fierce battle raged around Chengdu International Airport below, while a pack of Wyverns pursued our private jet at twenty-five thousand feet.

hunks.baseline: It did not take my temporarily frozen brain long to reach a conclusion.
hunks.sol: It didn’t take my temporarily frozen brain long to reach a conclusion.

hunks.baseline: The name burst from my mouth like lightning.
hunks.sol: The name burst from my mouth like a thunderclap.

hunks.baseline: A week ago, by modern-world time, the highest-tier undead monster had appeared alongside an unprecedented monster wave. It had undoubtedly extended its sinister reach all the way here.
hunks.sol: A week ago in the modern world, the apex undead monster had appeared alongside an unprecedented monster wave. It had undoubtedly extended its sinister reach all the way here.

hunks.baseline: —I knew this would happen! We’re all dead!
hunks.sol: —I knew this would happen! We’re all as good as dead!

hunks.baseline: Human or monster, screams and shouts erupted from every direction as everyone fell into a panic.
hunks.sol: Human and monster alike, everyone was panicking. Screams and shouts erupted from every direction.

hunks.baseline: Only one person among them had retained any semblance of sanity.
hunks.sol: Only one person among them retained any semblance of sanity.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone, calm down! Nothing you’re worried about is going to happen!”
hunks.sol: “Everyone, calm down! What you’re afraid of isn’t going to happen!”

hunks.baseline: As expected of Team Leader Choi. Reliable as ever. He must have thought of a way to overcome this crisis.
hunks.sol: As expected of Team Leader Choi. Reliable as ever. He must have thought of a way out of this crisis.

hunks.baseline: After calming everyone down in a steady voice, Team Leader Choi pointed at me.
hunks.sol: After calming everyone with his steady voice, Team Leader Choi pointed at me.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung will solve this!”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung will handle it!”

hunks.baseline: That was exactly the problem. Why did he believe in me? In a situation like this, believing in God, Buddha, or Allah would probably be more useful.
hunks.sol: That was exactly the problem. Why did he believe in me? In a situation like this, believing in God, Buddha, or Allah would probably do him more good.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I lost my ability to speak. Then the gazes of everyone around me flew toward me and pierced into my body.
hunks.sol: As I stood there speechless, everyone’s gaze snapped toward me.

hunks.baseline: —You, wicked human! I knew you were strong, but this is beyond my imagination! Rejoice, my legion. Your commander lives!
hunks.sol: —You, wicked human! I knew you were strong, but this is beyond anything I imagined! Rejoice, my legion. Your commander lives!

hunks.baseline: I stared at Team Leader Choi with utter disbelief.
hunks.sol: I stared at Team Leader Choi in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “Which means, where does that baseless faith—”
hunks.sol: “That’s what I’m asking. Where is this baseless faith coming from—”

hunks.baseline: “It is not baseless.”
hunks.sol: “It isn’t baseless.”

hunks.baseline: “Excuse me?”
hunks.sol: “What?”

hunks.baseline: “The way you are acting in a situation like this. Your tone of voice. Your expression. All of it is the basis for my belief.”
hunks.sol: “The way you’re acting in a situation like this. Your tone. Your expression. All of it gives me reason to believe in you.”

hunks.baseline: Only then did I finally realize it.
hunks.sol: Only then did I realize the truth.

hunks.baseline: I had been caught off guard by the unexpected situation, but I was not afraid. I did not feel even the slightest bit of fear or dread.
hunks.sol: The unexpected situation had caught me off guard, but I wasn’t afraid. I didn’t feel the slightest trace of fear or dread.

hunks.baseline: The answer was closer than I had thought.
hunks.sol: The answer was simpler than I’d thought.

hunks.baseline: I was strong. Stronger than before. Strong enough to avoid any danger.
hunks.sol: I was strong. Stronger than before. Strong enough to weather any danger.

hunks.baseline: That was why I was not afraid of the monsters sweeping across the ground like a wave, or the pack of Wyverns closing in right behind us.
hunks.sol: That was why I wasn’t afraid of the monsters sweeping across the ground like a wave, or the pack of Wyverns closing in right behind us.

hunks.baseline: “So that’s how it is…”
hunks.sol: “So that’s what it is…”

hunks.baseline: I muttered quietly to myself, then opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: I muttered under my breath, then spoke up.

hunks.baseline: A hand suddenly rose from the cockpit ahead.
hunks.sol: A hand suddenly shot up from the cockpit ahead.

hunks.baseline: It was trembling violently. With his other hand, the captain was probably gripping the controls for dear life and desperately trying to evade the Wyverns charging at us.
hunks.sol: It was trembling violently. The captain was probably using his other hand to clutch the controls for dear life and desperately evade the Wyverns bearing down on us.

hunks.baseline: “I’m asking if it’s okay for me to open the plane door.”
hunks.sol: “I’m asking if I can open the plane door.”

hunks.baseline: The captain must have been so shocked that he poked his head out and stared at me as if I were insane.
hunks.sol: The question must have shocked him senseless, because he poked his head out and stared at me like I was insane.

hunks.baseline: “Of course not! Not only is it impossible to open because of the pressure-sealing system, but the aircraft will be damaged because it can’t withstand the pressure difference! You won’t even be able to breathe properly!”
hunks.sol: “Of course not! The pressure-sealing system won’t even let you open it, and the aircraft would be damaged by the pressure difference! You wouldn’t be able to breathe properly either!”

hunks.baseline: “I think I can block the pressure. I don’t know what you have in mind, but go ahead and try.”
hunks.sol: “I think I can block the pressure. I don’t know what you have in mind, but give it a try.”

hunks.baseline: “…What, *bangzi*?”[^1]
hunks.sol: “…What did you call us? *Bangzi*?”[^1]

hunks.baseline: [^1]: *Bangzi* is a derogatory Chinese term for Koreans.
I could not believe he had insulted Koreans in front of a proud Korean Kimchi Man.
hunks.sol: How dare he insult Koreans in front of a proud Korean Kimchi Man?

hunks.baseline: The captain’s face went pale when he realized his verbal slip.
hunks.sol: The captain’s face went pale when he realized what had slipped out.

hunks.baseline: “You chink bastard. Damn it.”
hunks.sol: “You chink bastard. The fuck did you say?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes, yes?”
hunks.sol: “Y-Yes?”

hunks.baseline: “Should I open it?”
hunks.sol: “I’m opening it.”

hunks.baseline: Before the captain had time to stop me, I opened the door.
hunks.sol: Before the captain could stop me, I opened the door.

hunks.baseline: Force—the phenomenon called an Aura Blade in modern times—cut through the sturdy alloy and created a small opening.
hunks.sol: Force—the phenomenon known as an Aura Blade in the modern world—sliced through the sturdy alloy, creating a small opening.

hunks.baseline: It was the kind of overwhelming power that only an S-rank Hunter could display here, just as a Supreme Peak master could in the Murim.
hunks.sol: It was the kind of overwhelming power only a Supreme Peak master could display in Murim, or an S-rank Hunter here.

hunks.baseline: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, this is…”
hunks.sol: “Mr. Jin Taekyung, this is…!”

hunks.baseline: This was no time to be surprised. The tremendous wind and pressure had sent the aircraft swaying, turning the cabin into a complete mess.
hunks.sol: This was no time to stand around gawking. The tremendous wind and pressure had sent the aircraft lurching and thrown the cabin into chaos.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi came to his senses at the people’s screams and my shout, then rubbed his ring.
hunks.sol: The passengers’ screams and my shout brought Team Leader Choi back to his senses. He rubbed his ring.

hunks.baseline: “A flawless barrier surrounds us. Barrier!”
hunks.sol: “An impenetrable barrier surrounds us. Barrier!”

hunks.baseline: Along with the incantation, a transparent mana barrier blocked the new opening without leaving so much as a gap.
hunks.sol: With the incantation, a transparent membrane of energy sealed the new opening without leaving the slightest gap.

hunks.baseline: So there was a way to do that.
hunks.sol: So that was one way to do it.

hunks.baseline: With a brief exclamation of admiration, I stuck my upper body outside the cabin.
hunks.sol: With a brief murmur of admiration, I stuck my upper body outside the cabin.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi’s barrier spell recognized me as an ally and let me pass through without resistance.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi’s Barrier spell recognized me as an ally and let me pass through without resistance.

hunks.baseline: The wind pressure slammed into my upper body as if it wanted to crush me. I grinned.
hunks.sol: The wind pressure battered my upper body as if trying to crush me to death. I grinned.

hunks.baseline: But it was not unbearable.
hunks.sol: But it wasn’t unbearable.

hunks.baseline: No, it would have been strange if I could not withstand it. Compared to the energy waves emitted by the Western Heaven Demon Lord, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.
hunks.sol: No, it would have been stranger if I couldn’t endure it. Compared to the waves of energy the Western Heaven Demon Lord had unleashed, this was no more than a gentle spring breeze.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s sharp cry blended into that spring breeze.
hunks.sol: A monster’s shrill cry mingled with that spring breeze.

hunks.baseline: The pack of Wyverns had already approached within a short distance, and I estimated the gap between us.
hunks.sol: The pack of Wyverns had already drawn close. I judged the distance between us.

hunks.baseline: A spear purchased at a discount from the Hunter Market slid into my hand.
hunks.sol: A spear I’d bought at a discount from the Hunter Market slid into my hand.

hunks.baseline: Like a javelin thrower, I pulled my shoulder as far back as I could. From my waist to my wrist, every muscle and tendon I needed drew taut like bowstrings.
hunks.sol: Like a javelin thrower, I drew my shoulder as far back as it would go. From my waist to my wrist, every necessary muscle and tendon pulled taut like a bowstring.

hunks.baseline: The leader Wyvern at the front noticed that something was wrong and threw its head back with a shriek.
hunks.sol: Sensing something was wrong, the leader Wyvern at the front shrieked and threw back its head.

hunks.baseline: I could see a mass of pure-white air being sucked toward its snout.
hunks.sol: I could see streams of pure-white air being sucked toward its snout.

hunks.baseline: The Skeleton Warlord’s shout was correct.
hunks.sol: The Skeleton Warlord was right.

hunks.baseline: Among countless monsters, Breath was a power granted only to the dragonkin. I could clearly see it taking shape inside the Wyvern’s wide-open maw.
hunks.sol: Of all the countless monsters in existence, Breath was a power granted only to the dragonkin. I could clearly see it taking shape inside the Wyvern’s gaping maw.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic sphere of wind. An Air Breath capable of shredding metal like paper had taken complete shape.
hunks.sol: A gigantic sphere of wind. The instant the Air Breath, powerful enough to shred metal like paper, fully took shape—

hunks.baseline: I shouted like a thunderbolt and whipped my pulled-back shoulder forward.
hunks.sol: With a thunderous shout, I whipped my drawn-back shoulder forward.

hunks.baseline: The Force of flame wrapped around the spearhead, scorching the air and slicing through the wind.
hunks.sol: Flaming Force enveloped the spearhead, scorching the air and slicing through the wind.

hunks.baseline: The Wyvern’s bright-yellow eyes widened at the blue-white streak of light shooting straight toward it.
hunks.sol: The Wyvern’s bright-yellow eyes widened as the blue-white streak of light shot straight toward it.

hunks.baseline: Compressed air burst from the tip of the spear. A cloud of pure white formed, and then—
hunks.sol: Compressed air erupted from the spear’s tip. A pure-white cloud burst outward, and then—

hunks.baseline: A gigantic body fell toward the ground like a kite whose string had been cut.
hunks.sol: The gigantic body plummeted toward the ground like a kite with its string cut.

hunks.baseline: More than ten pairs of bright-yellow eyes looked at one another.
hunks.sol: More than ten pairs of bright-yellow eyes turned toward one another.

hunks.baseline: Wyverns were ferocious creatures from the moment they were born, but even they were utterly bewildered at that moment, unable to figure out what to do.
hunks.sol: Wyverns were ferocious from the moment they were born, but right now, they were so bewildered that they had no idea what to do.

hunks.baseline: After exchanging words among themselves, the Wyverns were dumbfounded.
hunks.sol: After exchanging a few words in their own language, the Wyverns were dumbfounded.

hunks.baseline: Their leader was an exceptionally powerful creature, strong enough to be called the “Black Star” among its kind.
hunks.sol: Their leader had been exceptional even among its own kind, powerful enough to earn the name “Black Star.”

hunks.baseline: And now, the Black Star had become a black dot as it fell toward the distant ground below.
hunks.sol: And now, the Black Star had become a black dot plummeting toward the distant ground.

hunks.baseline: What was more, none of them had properly seen how it died.
hunks.sol: None of them had even gotten a proper look at how it died.

hunks.baseline: They could only guess that the tiny human had thrown a spear and hit it.
hunks.sol: They could only guess that the tiny human had thrown a spear and struck it.

hunks.baseline: But that was ridiculous.
hunks.sol: But that was absurd.

hunks.baseline: How could a mere human dare to attack a descendant of the great dragon—
hunks.sol: How could a mere human dare attack a descendant of the great dragons—

hunks.baseline: After their leader, another of their bloodline had died!
hunks.sol: First their leader, and now another of their bloodline!

hunks.baseline: …Could they actually get their revenge?
hunks.sol: …Would they even get the chance?

hunks.baseline: More than ten pairs of wings began beating for dear life.
hunks.sol: More than ten pairs of wings began flapping for dear life.
[^1]: *Bangzi* is a derogatory Chinese term for Koreans.
